office_does: A Yakima County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil cases up to $100,000, small claims and protection orders; the four judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: appointed Judge Julia A. Davis is the only candidate for both the short and full terms.

candidates.summary: Yakima County District Court judge since her 2025 appointment, after 13 years as a county deputy prosecutor; the only candidate on the ballot for the short and full terms.
highlights: Appointed by county commissioners in March 2025; on the bench since April 2025 [S1][S2]
Deputy prosecutor 2011-2025; supervised the Special Assault Unit [S1][S2]
On the ballot for both the unexpired short term and the full four-year term [S4]
